parameters.description: The code to run. Can be a file ID from within Shuffle.
parameters.name: code
parameters.value:
import winrm

host = "192.168.65.151"
username = "administrator"
password = "admin@123"

# Wrap execution inside explicit elevated PowerShell command
ps_script = 'powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName \'Shuffle-Isolation\' -Direction Outbound -Action Block -Enabled True"'

session = winrm.Session(
    target=f'http://{host}:5985/wsman',
    auth=(username, password),
    transport='ntlm'
)

result = session.run_ps(ps_script)

if result.status_code != 0:
    raise Exception(f"WinRM Error Output: {result.std_err.decode('utf-8')}")

print("Output:", result.std_out.decode('utf-8'))
